novel_features.name: Aligned spec matrix
novel_features.description: Compare N products side-by-side as a normalized attribute matrix with a price row, so 'which meets 220V and >=700W' is one command instead of six browser tabs.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join of each product's attributes against the category attribute schema to align columns that sellers expose inconsistently — no single Mercado Livre call returns this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent must justify a procurement choice across candidate listings with differing spec labels.

novel_features.name: Cheapest meeting spec floor
novel_features.description: Find the lowest-priced listing that satisfies attribute floors like voltage and power, evaluated against locally synced spec data.
novel_features.rationale: Evaluates =/>=/<= predicates over the local attribute table then sorts by price — a mechanical filter no generic API client offers.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer 'cheapest that meets spec' without eyeballing mismatched seller attribute sets.

novel_features.name: Cross-seller price dispersion
novel_features.description: Report min/max/median/stddev of prices across the multiple sellers a single Mercado Livre catalog product aggregates.
novel_features.rationale: Exploits Mercado Livre's catalog structure where one /p/MLB product page fronts many seller offers; the spread is a local aggregation over synced rows.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to gauge whether a quoted price is competitive against the full seller spread for the same catalog item.

novel_features.name: Price drift over time
novel_features.description: Show how a product's price changed across repeated local snapshots, with an optional --since window.
novel_features.rationale: Delta over locally accumulated price_snapshot rows — history no live API call can reconstruct.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to catch supplier price creep on recurring consumables before it hits a PO.

novel_features.name: Cotacao quotation bundle
novel_features.description: Assemble a purchase-request-shaped quotation across chosen products with price, seller, key specs, and captured_at provenance.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-entity join of product+attribute+seller+latest price into the domain artifact procurement actually signs off on, with a decision-time audit trail.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to emit the final cotação document instead of a raw table dump.

novel_features.name: Freshness gate
novel_features.description: List products whose newest price snapshot is older than a threshold, so a cotacao is never built on cold prices.
novel_features.rationale: Local captured_at query over price_snapshot — a data-validity guard with no API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before finalizing a quote to confirm every price is fresh enough to trust.

narrative.headline: Search Mercado Livre, compare prices and technical specs across listings, and build cotações — offline-persisted and agent-native, for procurement automation.
narrative.value_prop: A buyer-side CLI for procurement/suprimentos: it extracts stable JSON-LD from Mercado Livre search and product pages (clearing the captcha wall with an imported Chrome session), persists prices and spec attributes to a local SQLite store, and adds comparison commands no scraper offers — an aligned spec matrix (compare), cheapest-meeting-spec (cheapest), cross-seller price dispersion (dispersion), and cotação bundles with decision-time provenance.
narrative.auth_narrative: Mercado Livre serves search and product pages behind a captcha wall to plain HTTP clients. Run 'auth login --chrome' to import your logged-in Chrome cookies; the CLI replays requests with a Chrome fingerprint (no resident browser). The no-auth helper endpoints (category attributes, domain discovery, autosuggest) work without any login.

quickstart.comment: import Chrome cookies to clear the captcha wall
search with prices; auto-persists listings + a price snapshot to the local store
fetch full technical specs for a candidate; persists product + attributes
aligned spec matrix, only differing rows
cheapest listing meeting the spec floor

troubleshoots.fix: Re-run 'auth login --chrome' to refresh imported cookies; ensure you are logged into mercadolivre.com.br in Chrome.

troubleshoots.symptom: compare shows empty columns for some attributes
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'products get <id>' on both products first; sellers expose different attribute sets, and fetching each product populates its spec attributes.
Price history builds from repeated captures; re-run 'listings' or 'products get' on a schedule to accumulate snapshots.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or analyst needs to turn Mercado Livre listings into a procurement decision: searching by term, comparing prices and technical specs across candidate products, finding the cheapest option meeting a spec floor, or assembling a cotação with a price-at-decision audit trail. It is the right tool for suprimentos automation where the official API is gated and manual browsing does not scale.
